title: Docs: reference model changelog + change-management for Dedicated/Private
author: Kira Thompson
description: Summary: Updates Dedicated + Private documentation to consistently reference the new customer-visible Model Changelog (docs + Console) and set expectations for change-management (version pinning, deprecation timelines, and auditability). This is intended to reduce support escalations where customers see behavior changes but don’t know where to look. Context: aligns with the Model Metadata Schema + Changelog workstream (ENG-4921) and the docs-site release notes section introduced in PR #982 / feeds in PR #1004. What changed: (1) Added explicit “Model change-management” sections to Dedicated and Private overview docs; (2) Added cross-links to the model changelog landing page + RSS/JSON feed docs; (3) Documented how pinned model versions map to changelog entries (including where to find resolved model_version + changelog_url in API responses); (4) Added Console UI screenshots for the new “Changelog” tab + Rollouts linkage (feature-flagged) with captions that avoid internal terminology; (5) Added an enterprise-focused FAQ: audit/immutability expectations, approval workflow, and how to export/share links for internal change-control. Notes/constraints: keep wording customer-safe and avoid implying we provide per-customer customized release notes in v1. Also avoid naming internal model nicknames, internal event IDs, or vendor/procurement details. Test plan: build docs locally (pnpm docs:build), run markdown lint + link check; verify new anchors and redirects; confirm screenshots render correctly in both light/dark themes; confirm changelog links match current paths from PR #982 and feed docs from PR #1004. Screenshots: attached below (Console model page -> Changelog tab; Console rollouts page -> “View release note” link).
commits: docs(dedicated): add change-management section + changelog references
docs(private): add change-management expectations + audit FAQ
docs(api): add note on model_version + changelog_url fields for OpenAI-compatible routes

chore: fix broken links/anchors; add redirects for moved headings
checks: CI: docs-build (pass) • markdownlint (pass) • link-check (pass) • image-optim (pass) • spellcheck (pass). Preview: Vercel deploy generated successfully; reviewer preview links posted in thread.
review_conversation: Elliot Price (review): Please tighten the language around “immutability” — we should say changelog entries are tamper-evident and retained, but not promise customer-facing WORM semantics unless Security has signed off on exact phrasing. Also, link to the canonical model changelog landing page rather than describing URL patterns. Kira Thompson (author): Updated wording to “tamper-evident + retained per contract” and moved URL details into the model changelog page; added a note that retention varies by plan. Wei Chen (review): Screenshot captions look good, but can we avoid “behind feature flag” phrasing in public docs? Maybe “Availability may vary by account/region during rollout.” Kira Thompson: Adjusted captions accordingly and added a short callout under Console section. Paula Mendes (review): In the “Pinning” section, please clarify that rollouts will reference the changelog entry at time of change (helps change-control). Kira Thompson: Added a paragraph under Dedicated Rollouts -> “Change tracking” plus a screenshot reference. Marcus Lin (review): Security note: remove mention of internal approval states (draft/in_review) from customer docs; keep it at “reviewed before publication.” Also, ensure we don’t imply audit logs expose employee identities to customers. Kira Thompson: Removed state names; updated audit language to “includes actor attribution in internal audit logs; customer access via enterprise audit exports depending on configuration.” Connor O'Brien (review): Looks good. Minor: add sentence about release freeze windows for Dedicated if customers ask “why did this note publish later than the actual rollout?” Kira Thompson: Added a single sentence in Dedicated change-management FAQ: “Publication may follow release-train windows; see Console for effective dates.” Approvals: Elliot (approved), Wei (approved), Paula (approved), Marcus (approved), Connor (approved).
release_notes: Customer docs now reference the Model Changelog for Dedicated/Private, including how to subscribe (RSS/JSON) and how to use changelog links for internal change-management; added Console UI screenshots for the Changelog tab and rollouts linkage.
